clues.text: On a mountain in the land of Moriah, his father bound him and laid him on the altar atop the wood.
Walking up the mountain with his father, he asked where the lamb for the burnt offering was.
Abraham held a great feast on the day this child was weaned.
Meditating in a field one evening, he looked up and saw camels bringing his future bride.
Old and unable to see, he said a son's voice was Jacob's but the hands were Esau's.
After the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled over his wells, he dug another and named it Rehoboth.
Afraid of the men of Gerar, he told them his beautiful wife Rebekah was his sister.
